summary: The session focuses on the challenges faced by data management leaders in preparing for AI integration, emphasizing the need for an AI-ready data foundation and a future-proof architecture. Key topics include the importance of federated data management practices, operational excellence, and the automation of data governance. The speaker highlights the necessity of continuous data readiness assessments and the evolving role of data management in supporting AI use cases.

key_points: Data management leaders face sleepless nights due to the challenges of AI integration.
The availability and quality of data are the primary barriers to successful AI use cases.
Establish a future-proof architecture and platform for data management.
Operational excellence and governance as code are essential for scaling data management.
The rise of unstructured data requires new management strategies.
Data products and self-service capabilities are becoming increasingly important.
Federated governance models can enhance business value from data solutions.
Domain ownership is crucial for enabling business functions to build their own data products.
Separation of data engineering and platform engineering improves efficiency.
Automation and orchestration are critical for managing data pipelines effectively.

key_takeaways: Establish a continuous process for assessing data readiness for AI use cases.
Invest in federated data management practices to empower business users.
Automate data governance processes to ensure compliance and efficiency.
